acc.title: Accounts
acc.emptyDesc: Sign in or add an account to get started
acc.microsoftSubtitle: Sign in with a Microsoft account to add a premium account
acc.deviceCodeHint: Open the link below in your browser and enter the device code
acc.stepsHint: Follow these steps to sign in
acc.step2: Enter the device code shown above
acc.step3: Sign in with your Microsoft account and authorize
acc.yggSubtitle: Sign in to an external account with a Yggdrasil authentication server
acc.authServerHint: Choose a preset server or enter a custom domain
acc.serverNote: Enter the domain only; the launcher appends /api/yggdrasil automatically
acc.accountInfoHint: Enter the account and password you registered on the authentication server
acc.offlineSubtitle: Create a local offline account — no sign-in required
acc.yggProfilesHint: Multiple profiles were found on this account; select one or more to add as accounts
acc.yggPickRequired: Please select at least one profile
acc.importSubtitle: Read accounts from another launcher and review them before importing
acc.import.pcl2Description: Choose a PCL2 .reg registry export. On Windows, you can also read the current user’s local registry without changing it. Decryption requires a known source identifier and is not guaranteed for standard releases. Accounts whose credentials cannot be recovered require sign-in again.
acc.import.hmclDescription: Supports legacy hmcl.json and newer accounts.json or user-accounts.json. Newer files need the matching private/account-private-data.json or private/user-account-private-data.json. Select both files together or follow the second file prompt. Missing private data, source OAuth parameters or unrecoverable credentials may limit an account to temporary use or require sign-in again.
acc.import.officialDescription: Supports the official launcher’s launcher_accounts.json and legacy launcher_profiles.json. Microsoft refresh tokens usually cannot be transferred directly. Existing game credentials may work only until they expire, after which sign-in is required. Accounts marked as requiring sign-in cannot be selected.
acc.import.hmclFile: hmcl.json / accounts.json (optionally together with its matching private/account-private-data.json)
acc.importRegistryHint: Reads only the current Windows user’s local PCL2 registry settings without changing the source data. You can also choose an exported .reg file below.
acc.importWaiting: Choose a file or wait for reading to finish
acc.importNoEntries: No accounts were found to preview. Check the source or choose another file.
acc.importError: Could not complete the import. The preview and selection have been cleared. Choose the source files again or read local PCL2 accounts to retry.
acc.import.temporaryNote: This account works only until its current credentials expire. You will then need to sign in again.
acc.import.refreshNote: Importing validates and refreshes credentials online. The source launcher’s token may rotate and it may require sign-in again.
acc.import.warning.protected: Some sources lack recoverable credentials or OAuth parameters, or use an unsupported encryption format. Accounts may be temporarily usable or require sign-in again.
acc.import.warning.unsupported: Unsupported accounts or data formats were found in the source and have been skipped.
acc.import.warning.invalid: Invalid or incomplete account data was found in the source and has been skipped.
